purpose: Define deterministic certification validation over certification identity, package/hash subject, registry state, issuer/profile and cache freshness, producing explicit valid/invalid/unverifiable outcomes.

topics.name: Certification Validation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic certification validation over certification identity, package/hash subject, registry state, issuer/profile and cache freshness, producing explicit valid/invalid/unverifiable outcomes.

semantics.valid_rule: Valid requires exact subject/hash match and non-revoked/non-expired certification evidence.
semantics.invalid_rule: Hash mismatch, revoked status, wrong subject/profile or invalid issuer evidence produces invalid.
semantics.unverifiable_rule: Evidence unavailable or stale without authoritative confirmation produces unverifiable, never valid.
semantics.license_rule: Commercial license status is not a certification-validation input unless a separate policy explicitly requires both for deployment.
semantics.runtime_rule: Valid certification remains orthogonal to AccessCore/runtime authorization.
semantics.evidence_rule: Validation result retains exact evidence/cache/registry refs.

invariants.rule: Certification is explicit technical evidence bound to an exact package/artifact snapshot; commercial payment, license status or runtime authorization never substitute for certification evidence.

hard_gates.condition: license payment substituted for technical evidence

references.purpose: Validation may use valid cached evidence.

prose.summary: Define deterministic certification validation over certification identity, package/hash subject, registry state, issuer/profile and cache freshness, producing explicit valid/invalid/unverifiable outcomes.
